events.title: US-Iran war — Day 175; 'crushing economic operation' announced
events.why_it_matters: Treasury Secretary Bessent announced 'the toughest sanctions in history' on Iran, with details on Aug 24; Brent near $95/bbl, WTI ~$88. Oil is the single biggest macro variable, and escalation threatens supply and inflation.
events.what_to_watch: Monday's Bessent press conference and any Iranian retaliation.

events.title: China unveils new consumption stimulus measures
events.why_it_matters: NDRC and Finance Ministry announced credit subsidies for cars and home renovations, plus county-level consumption programs, effective Aug 1, to counter weak July data (GDP 4.7% H1).
events.what_to_watch: Whether measures are big enough to lift the slowing economy.

events.title: US PCE inflation (July) release
events.why_it_matters: Fed's preferred gauge; consensus expects core PCE ~2.9-3.0% YoY given the energy shock, shaping whether the Fed hikes or holds at Sept 16 FOMC.
events.what_to_watch: Core PCE vs consensus and any upward revision.

events.title: US Q2 GDP second estimate
events.why_it_matters: Advance showed 1.5% annualized (down from 2.1% Q1), confirming a growth slowdown amid the energy shock.

events.title: Jackson Hole Economic Symposium
events.why_it_matters: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's first keynote as chair on Aug 28; markets are pricing a possible 25bp HIKE at Sept FOMC.
events.what_to_watch: Any hawkish signal on rates or inflation.

events.title: US jobs report (August)
events.why_it_matters: Final labor reading before Sept FOMC; July showed -23,000 payrolls (first negative print of cycle) vs +80k consensus, signaling stagflation risk.

events.title: FOMC meeting
events.why_it_matters: Markets now pricing a ~25bp HIKE (not cut) after July's 9-3 hold at 3.50-3.75%; Warsh's Fed has shifted hawkish due to energy-driven inflation.
events.what_to_watch: SEP projections and Warsh's press conference.

events.title: ECB meeting
events.why_it_matters: ECB raised rates 25bp in June citing Middle East war inflation; a September move is 'almost fully priced in.'
events.what_to_watch: Whether ECB hikes again and messaging on pace.

events.title: Bank of Japan meeting
events.why_it_matters: Sources say BoJ set to hike as soon as September, possibly more aggressively than the current ~2x/year pace; rates currently 0.75%.
events.what_to_watch: BoJ's decision and any guidance on faster tightening.

events.title: China PMI (August)
events.why_it_matters: July official PMI fell to 50.9 (below 51.5 consensus); confirms China slowdown and pressure for more stimulus.

events.title: Nvidia Q2 FY2027 earnings
events.why_it_matters: The AI bellwether; revenue guidance ~$91B. A miss or weak guidance could hit the entire tech complex.
events.what_to_watch: Data center revenue, Rubin chip ramp, guidance.

events.title: Salesforce earnings
events.why_it_matters: Cloud/software bellwether.

events.title: PDD Holdings, XPeng, Tuya earnings
events.why_it_matters: China consumption and EV demand signals.

events.title: US-Iran sanctions details press conference
events.why_it_matters: Bessent to outline sanctions campaign; 'you're either with us or against us' on allies. Could push oil higher and hit global trade.

events.title: OPEC+ meeting
events.why_it_matters: Group approved 188k bpd September hike (completing rollback of voluntary cuts); expected to PAUSE further hikes after September.
events.what_to_watch: Whether they pause or continue hikes.

events.title: US midterm elections building
events.why_it_matters: Markets expect limited near-term impact but divided-government risk rising.

events.title: Drone Section 232 tariffs effective
events.why_it_matters: Trump imposed 25-100% tariffs on imported drones/components (Aug 13 proclamation); hits DJI (70-90% US market share) and drone supply chains.

events.title: Atlantic hurricane season active
events.why_it_matters: NOAA updated outlook calls for above-normal activity; Gulf energy infrastructure risk.

events.title: US-Iran ceasefire expired
events.why_it_matters: Trump said US won't extend the 60-day MOU; talks at standstill. War continues (Day 175). Oil supply risk persists; Strait of Hormuz remains contested.

events.title: US national debt crossed $40 trillion
events.why_it_matters: Treasury reported $432B July deficit (highest monthly in years); fiscal sustainability concerns; Treasury buyback announcement followed.
events.what_to_watch: Bond market reaction and Treasury issuance plans.

events.title: Treasury doubled long-dated bond buybacks
events.why_it_matters: Surprise move after 10-yr yields hit ~4.68% (highest in ~2 decades); administration acting to cap yields; bond vigilante pressure.
events.what_to_watch: Whether buybacks stabilize the long end.

events.title: US CPI (July) release
events.why_it_matters: +0.1% MoM, +3.4% YoY, matching consensus; core 0.22% MoM. Downward trend from 3.8% peak but energy shock looms.

events.title: US jobs report (July) release
events.why_it_matters: -23,000 payrolls vs +80k consensus; unemployment 4.1%. First negative print of cycle; labor market weakening.

events.title: China LPR held
events.why_it_matters: 1-yr at 3.0%, 5-yr at 3.5% for 15th straight month; no monetary easing; fiscal measures taking precedence.

events.title: Senate passed stopgap funding bill
events.why_it_matters: Extends government funding to Dec 11, averting Sept 30 shutdown.

events.title: South Korea chip exports record
events.why_it_matters: $26B in first 20 days of August, up 199% YoY; memory up 277%; confirms AI memory supercycle.

events.title: TSMC raised 2026 CapEx to $60-64B
events.why_it_matters: AI demand strong; 45% sales surge; confirms AI capex boom.

events.title: China July data weak
events.why_it_matters: GDP 4.7% H1; extreme weather disrupted supply/demand; pressure for more stimulus.

events.title: ECB raised rates 25bp
events.why_it_matters: Middle East war inflation; global tightening.

events.title: BoJ held at 1%
events.why_it_matters: Warned core inflation likely to exceed 2% target from September; sets up September hike.

events.title: Fed held at 3.50-3.75%
events.why_it_matters: 9-3 vote; three members voted to hike; hawkish shift under Warsh.

events.title: World Cup 2026 final
events.why_it_matters: Spain beat Argentina 1-0; no longer market-relevant.

top_risks: US-Iran war escalation / sanctions blowback — Bessent's 'toughest sanctions in history' could push Brent above $100 and reignite global inflation, forcing more aggressive Fed tightening.
Fed rate HIKE at Sept 16 — Markets now pricing a hike, not a cut; Warsh's hawkish debut at Jackson Hole could confirm. A hike amid weakening jobs (-23k) risks a policy error.
Bond market stress — 10-yr yields near 2-decade highs; Treasury buybacks are a stopgap, not a fix. $40T debt and $432B monthly deficit raise fiscal sustainability questions.
China slowdown without adequate stimulus — LPR held for 15 months; new consumption measures may be too small. Weak PMI and GDP could drag global growth.
Stagflation mix — Negative payrolls + 3.4% CPI + oil near $95 = classic stagflation setup that's hard for any central bank to manage.
top_opportunities: AI/semiconductor supercycle — Nvidia earnings Aug 26, TSMC $60-64B capex, Korea chip exports +199%, memory +277%. AI demand is the strongest growth story.
Energy producers — Oil near $95 with supply risk from Iran war and OPEC+ pausing hikes after September.
Treasury buyback support — Administration's willingness to intervene in bond market could stabilize long-end yields, supporting duration-sensitive assets.
China consumption stimulus — New credit subsidies for cars/home renovations could lift consumer cyclicals if measures prove meaningful.
Post-midterm seasonality — Historically markets perform better after midterms as uncertainty clears; positioning for Nov 3 could start building.
summary: The global macro landscape is dominated by the US-Iran war (Day 175) with oil near $95 and a 'crushing economic operation' of sanctions announced, threatening supply and inflation. The Fed under Warsh has turned hawkish, with markets pricing a potential September HIKE despite a weakening labor market (-23k July payrolls), creating stagflation risk. Bond markets are under stress with 10-yr yields near 2-decade highs, prompting Treasury buyback intervention. China's slowdown persists with new consumption stimulus measures unveiled, while the AI/semiconductor supercycle remains the strongest growth story ahead of Nvidia earnings. Multiple interacting risk factors—geopolitical, monetary, fiscal, and economic—create a high-uncertainty environment with no clear resolution path.
